As Apple (AAPL) Market Value Rose, Shareholder Pathstone Family Office Has Upped Holding; Invesco LTD Position in 2U (TWOU) Raised as Market Valuation Rose
May 29, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers
Pathstone Family Office Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 26.2% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pathstone Family Office Llc bought 3,359 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 16,181 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.71M, up from 12,822 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pathstone Family Office Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $921.74B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.56% or $1.05 during the last trading session, reaching $187.53. About 11.21M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Invesco Ltd increased its stake in 2U Inc (TWOU) by 6.73% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Invesco Ltd bought 58,225 shares as the company’s stock rose 14.01% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 923,877 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $77.63 million, up from 865,652 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Invesco Ltd who had been investing in 2U Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.89B market cap company. The stock increased 0.43% or $0.39 during the last trading session, reaching $91.71. About 267,331 shares traded. 2U, Inc. (NASDAQ:TWOU) has risen 110.46% since May 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 97.89% the S&P500.
